2TI.1.3-5.text: Paul thanks God for Timothy’s sincere faith

2TI.1.6-7.text: Paul urges Timothy to use God’s gift without fear

2TI.1.8-11.text: Timothy must not be ashamed but suffer for the gospel

2TI.1.12-12.text: Paul is not ashamed of suffering because he trusts God

2TI.1.13-14.text: Timothy must hold to sound teaching and guard it

2TI.1.15-18.text: Many left Paul, but Onesiphorus helped him often

2TI.2.1-2.text: Timothy must be strong and train faithful men to teach

2TI.2.3-5.text: Timothy must suffer like a soldier and a competitor

check.why: The verses speak of competing according to the rules, not of suffering like an athlete.
check.suggestion: Timothy must suffer as a soldier and compete by the rules

2TI.2.6-7.text: Paul says a hardworking farmer shares the crops first

check.why: The text says the farmer should be the first to receive and eat the crops, not give them away to others.
check.suggestion: A hardworking farmer should be first to receive the crops

2TI.2.8-10.text: Paul suffers in chains, but God’s word is not chained

2TI.2.11-13.text: A trusted saying about living and reigning with Christ

check.why: The title is a noun phrase rather than a full sentence.
check.suggestion: A trustworthy saying tells of dying and living with Christ

2TI.2.14-15.text: Timothy must remind believers not to quarrel over words

check.why: It mentions only verse 14 and leaves out the command to be an approved worker who correctly handles the truth.
check.suggestion: Timothy must warn against quarreling and handle truth well

2TI.2.16-18.text: Timothy must avoid empty talk and false teachers

2TI.2.19-21.text: Believers who clean themselves are useful to the Master

2TI.2.22-23.text: Timothy must flee youthful passions and pursue peace

2TI.2.24-26.text: The Lord’s servant must be kind and teach gently

2TI.3.1-4.text: In the last days men will be selfish and evil

2TI.3.5-7.text: Timothy must turn away from men who only seem godly

2TI.3.8-9.text: False teachers oppose the truth like Jannes and Jambres

2TI.3.10-13.text: The Lord rescued Paul; godly believers will be persecuted

2TI.3.14-15.text: Timothy must continue in what he learned from Scripture

2TI.3.16-17.text: Scripture is from God and equips believers for good work

2TI.4.1-2.text: Paul charges Timothy to preach the word

2TI.4.3-5.text: Men will reject truth, but Timothy must do his work

2TI.4.6-8.text: Paul has kept the faith and expects a crown

2TI.4.9-10.text: Paul asks Timothy to come quickly; Demas left Paul

2TI.4.11-13.text: Paul asks Timothy to bring Mark, his cloak and scrolls

2TI.4.14-15.text: Paul warns Timothy about Alexander, who harmed Paul

2TI.4.16-16.text: No one stood with Paul at his first defense

2TI.4.17-18.text: The Lord stood by Paul and will rescue him
